417506.description: This newly stocked pond near Red Deer is managed by the Alberta Conservation Association (ACA) and offers convenient access for recreational users. While amenities are currently limited, site development is ongoing and improvements will be added over time. The pond provides a great opportunity for anglers to enjoy trout fishing in a peaceful setting.
